correctness.rationale: Exact EF one-point extension signatures are complete for quantifier rank by induction, including repetitions and all moves. Two independently encoded exhaustive implementations classify each size 3..24 at ranks 3,4; the large-cycle Duplicator gap invariant proves all sizes >=12 are rank-3 equivalent and all >=24 rank-4 equivalent. Finite bridge 11~12 and 19~24 together with separations yields exact sharp all-size classes. Limits: no higher-rank formula or outside-range computational claim.
